Software Developer Cloud & Distributed Systems 
 
   
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. 
 
 Who We Are: 

















































 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

















































 
 
 Job Description: 
    
 We are looking for a passionate Software Developer to join our Cloud Engineering team and help build the next generation of Mist’s cloud ‑ based network configuration and reporting platform. In this role, you will implement highly scalable distributed systems, own key cloud services end ‑ to ‑ end, and contribute to the platform that powers AI ‑ driven enterprise networking at massive scale. 
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Build, and maintain scalable, fault ‑ tolerant distributed services running in the cloud. 
 Develop microservices and backend components using Python and Go, with additional development in Java for event ‑ driven stream processing systems. 
 Build and evolve real ‑ time and batch data processing pipelines for AIDE (AI Driven Engineering), including event streams, ingestion pipelines, and ML ‑ driven workflows. 
 Write high ‑ quality unit, integration, and functional tests that enable safe refactoring and continuous delivery. 
 
 Education and Experience Required: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field. 
 Typically 2+ years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python, Go, or Java. 
 1+ years of experience building event ‑ driven stream processing systems using Kafka, Storm, Flink, or similar technologies. 
 
 Knowledge and Skills: 
 Strong understanding of RESTful API design and implementation. 
 Experience working with distributed datastores such as Redis, Cassandra, or Postgres. 
 1+ years building or operating distributed systems using cloud ‑ native technologies or Kubernetes. 
 1+ years working with big ‑ data frameworks such as Apache Spark or Databricks. 
 Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, and service ownership. 
 Familiarity with ETL pipelines, ML training and inference, or data tooling such as Pandas/DuckDB. 
 Familiarity with AI tools. 
 Good understanding of Linux and systems fundamental. 
 Strong analytical and problem ‑ solving skills. 
 Excellent communication and cross ‑ functional collaboration skills 
 
 
 
 
 What We Can Offer You: 










































 Health & Wellbeing 
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
 
 Personal & Professional Development 
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
 
 Unconditional Inclusion 
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
